title: stories save-version prints write before saving, so a crash looks like a saved version
description: story_commands.py prints the line ending in 'version N write' before save_story_version runs. When the save then fails, as it did with the missing markusmd, the output contains 'version 2 write' and nothing was saved. docs/story-reporting.md says the write line prints only after the save. stories versions showed only version 1. Fix: print it after the save, or make the first line a plan line.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Fixed in #1159, shipped in 5.84.0; #1175 added a spec. Note: save-version still requires --author-label when signed in, tracked separately.
